# QR Code Studio

> Open-source, privacy-first Android QR Code scanner and generator application built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and Google AI Studio.

## Overview

QR Code Studio is a modern, fully open-source Android app designed for fast, offline, and secure QR code scanning and generation.

It requires minimal permissions, uses Android's modern Photo Picker for gallery access, and processes all scan and generation data strictly on-device.

## Key Features

* **Privacy-First Architecture:** 100% on-device processing. Uses Android Photo Picker instead of broad media permissions (`READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`).
* **Live & Gallery Scanning:** Real-time scanning via CameraX with continuous scan mode support and gallery image scanning.
* **HD QR Code Generation:** Generate custom high-definition QR codes up to 2048x2048 pixels in PNG or JPEG formats.
* **Modern UI & Personalization:** Built with Jetpack Compose & Material 3, featuring Material You dynamic color support and 7 preset themes (e.g., AMOLED Black, Cyberpunk, Emerald).
* **Multilingual Support:** Supports over 50 languages with offline dictionary integration.
* **Offline History:** Local scan logs and custom codes saved securely via Jetpack Room database.

## Technical Details

* **Language:** 100% Kotlin
* **UI Framework:** Jetpack Compose & Material 3
* **Camera & Scanning:** Google CameraX & ZXing
* **Database:** Android Jetpack Room
* **AI Co-Development:** Google AI Studio
* **License:** MIT License
